subject: Urgent: Vantage peak sale surge — RCA delivery and exec recovery commitments
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@vantage-retail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vantage-retail.com
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Major latency + 5xx spike during 12:00-13:30 PT (peak sale)

Hi Mina / Redwood team,

We experienced a sustained period of high tail latency and increased 5xx errors between 12:00-13:30 PT during our promotional window today. Traffic was about 2.8x baseline; our checkout calls saw ~18% error rate at peak which triggered cascading retries. This materially affected checkout completion for ~7% of sessions.

We urgently need: a short RCA, corrective actions, and an executive readout for our board call next Wednesday. Also please include any temporary credits or SLA remediation language so we can present a proposed remediation to procurement.

I've attached basic logs and a narrower HAR sample.

Attachments: vantage_logs_0510.tar.gz (logs), checkout_har_sample.json

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Senior SRE, Vantage Retail
asha.patel@vantage-retail.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@vantage-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 15:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Major latency + 5xx spike during 12:00-13:30 PT (peak sale)

Asha — thanks for the detailed note and logs. I'm very sorry you hit this during a peak. We are opening a full RCA and prioritize a short executive readout. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Immediate bridge and mitigation (in progress) — Ben is leading temporary routing and scaling changes.
2) Collection & triage — we've pulled runtime traces and KV-cache stats, attaching an initial packet.
3) RCA draft & timeline — we'll deliver a 1-page executive summary by EOD Tue (5/15) and a full RCA + remediation plan by Wed (5/17).

Can you confirm the time of your board call so we ensure the exec readout version matches your ask?

I'll be your exec point-of-contact for the readout.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@vantage-retail.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Major latency + 5xx spike during 12:00-13:30 PT (peak sale)

On the bridge we observed:
- GPU pool 4 reached sustained queueing due to a hot prefix pattern from variant B of your model (large prompt fanout).
- Automatic batching latency surge + a degraded KV cache hit-rate (~63% -> 21%).

Immediate mitigations applied (completed at 16:00 PT):
- Forced failover of a subset of requests to model variant A (lower memory pressure) — reduced errors to ~3% in 20m.
- Temporarily increased burst capacity on Dedicated pool for your org.

I'm attaching the mitigation checklist and raw trace pack. We'll correlate with your logs and ship the RCA draft tomorrow morning.

Attachments: mitigation-checklist.xlsx

-Ben
Ben Carter
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@vantage-retail.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@vantage-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 09:28:00 -0400
Subject: Executive readout + RCA draft (v1) and commitments

Asha / Michael —

First, sincere apologies for the customer impact. Attached is RCA draft v1 (summary + timeline) and an initial set of corrective actions. Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Root cause: a combination of a sudden traffic fanout pattern that exposed a model variant memory amplification bug and an underperforming prefix cache eviction policy under extreme concurrency.
- Immediate effect: queueing at the serving runtime, longer API latencies, and elevated 5xxs as backpressure built.

Commitments from Redwood:
1) Short-term (0–72h): permanent routing to variant A for high-concurrency lanes; aggressive prefix cache warming for your hot prefixes. Target: reduce tail latency by 65% and 5xx < 1% under the same traffic profile.
2) Mid-term (2–3 weeks): runtime patch to the batching memory accounting (+ regression tests). We'll run a soak test under mirrored traffic.
3) Long-term (60–90 days): improved model-variant verification suite and customer-specific hot-prefix profiling in the Optimize product.

We are prepared to propose a one-time service credit for the impacted window; Kimberly from GTM will coordinate contractual language with procurement.

Deliverables & timeline:
- 2028-05-15 EOD: 1-page exec summary (v1) — CONFIRMED
- 2028-05-17 EOD: Full RCA + remediation playbook (v1) — IN PROGRESS
- 2028-06-01: Runtime patch roll & soak test start

Action items for Vantage: please confirm acceptance of temporary routing and whether you want Redwood exec to present the summary on your board call (share the exact time).

Attachments: rca_draft_v1.pdf
Link: https://jira.internal.redwood/browse/SRV-3124

—Jonas Weber
VP, Customer Solutions
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@vantage-retail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@vantage-retail.com>, procurement@vantage-retail.com
Date: Thu, 18 May 2028 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Executive readout + RCA draft (v1) and commitments

Thanks for the swift work and the clear plan. We reviewed the exec summary and RFC; the board call is 2028-05-20 at 11:00 PT and we'd like Redwood to present the 1-page summary (10 min).

Procurement asks for a proposed credit and formal SLA remediation language in the contract addendum — procurement@vantage-retail.com will coordinate. We accept the temporary routing and ask Redwood to:
- Share the full RCA + remediation playbook by EOD 5/17 as promised.
- Confirm the patch rollout date and provide an ETA on the soak results by 5/25.

We appreciate the responsiveness. Please copy legal on the credit proposal.

Regards,
Michael Torres
CEO, Vantage Retail
procurement@vantage-retail.com
